text:
Jordan: Heads-up — Raptor rollout to EU (eu-west1) starts TOMORROW 09:00 UTC. Perf harness shows raptor-large-8bit is ~3.1x tokens/sec vs current-mini. Expect promo window multiplier ~1.8x → net delta ≈ +1.9M tokens/s on EU edge.
Alex: Can you paste the estimate + GPU-hours delta? We need runway for autoscale and quota requests.
Jordan: Quick sketch: baseline EU peak tokens/s = 2.4M. With raptor + promo => projected peak ≈ 4.3M tokens/s. Avg req ~140 tokens. Bench: raptor-large-8bit ≈ 95k tokens/s per A100-equivalent. => ~45 A100-equivalent GPUs at peak. => ~1,080 GPU-hours for the 24h promo day, week tail ≈ 3,500 GPU-hours. Spreadsheet link: https://redwood-internal/sheets/raptor-capacity (internal).
Maria: 45 GPUs is optimistic — remember KV cache warmup + prefix churn gave us ~20% extra in prior launches. Also initial tail-latency spikes.
Jordan: Agreed. Add 20% safety => target 54 GPUs. Note region egress estimate +30TB/day (costy).
Alex: Region quotas? eu-west1 quota is 60 A100-equivalents on paper but 12 are reserved for Dedicated customers. That leaves ~48 free today.
Tim: Current free pool in eu-west1: 18 spotable + 6 on-demand spare nodes; 10 are used by canaries/tests. We need CloudOps uplift.
Kevin: Ops proposal: request +40 A100s in eu-west1, prewarm nodes starting T-2h, and lock a pool of 30 for preemptible fallback. Also prepare fallback routing to quantized variant: raptor-quant-4bit (~50% cheaper, +40ms median).
Jordan: Can we do prefix prewarm? If we preheat hot prefixes (top 30% by volume) we reduce warmup burst ~30%. Prewarm script ready: 
```bash
# prewarm hot prefixes
curl -X POST https://internal-prewarm/queue -d @hot_prefixes.json
```
Alex: Autoscale config suggestion: target_util = 0.75, scale_cooldown = 90s, max_scale_factor = 2.0. Add burst headroom: min_capacity = baseline + 20%.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment kicked: raptor-large-8bit -> 10% traffic (2026-03-19T07:00:00Z).
Maria: Observability needs: per-model token/s, per-pool GPU-util, tail-latency p99/p995, cache-hit-rate, and inter-region egress. Tag metrics with rollout_id=raptor-eu-0326 and alert on p99 > 1200ms or token/s delta > +25% vs target.
Jordan: Action items recap: 1) CloudOps quota request +40 GPUs (Kevin). 2) Prewarm run T-2h + script (Alex). 3) Autoscale config change (Tim). 4) Dashboards & alerts (Maria). 5) Cost guardrail: trigger if egress > +50% (SRE).
Alex: Filing support ticket with cloud provider now — ETA 6–8h for quota approval. If denied we'll: a) shift 30% of traffic to raptor-quant-4bit, b) tighten client-side rate limits, c) extend rollout window.
Tim: I'll prepare automated routing rule to throttle non-critical routes to 60% if GPU headroom < 10%.
Kevin: If provider can't meet quota, fallback plan B: spin extra capacity in nearby region (eu-central) + cross-region routing. Need to validate latency impact (~+25ms).
Jordan: One more: enable cost alarms on project spend and egress, and notify on-call with pager if thresholds hit.
Maria: I'll create the dashboard now and add synthetic tests for hot prompt families. Will post link when ready.
Alex: Ticket #CLD-2248 filed. Adding contact: cloud-support@provider. Keeping this thread updated. :thumbsup:
Jordan: Thanks — meet back in 6h for status. If quota arrives we proceed with prewarm; otherwise we flip to quantized canary and slower ramp. :crossed_fingers:
